assumptions.snapshot: complete host-bound rows with unique integer IDs

boundaries: no statistical freeze or phase acceptance

comparison_precision.purpose: floating SQLite computation reconciliation only; never used for winner selection

grammar.ctes: up to three acyclic single-source projection/filter or aggregate stages; no recursive/nested WITH
expressions: SUM(CASE WHEN blocked=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
division only by nonzero constants or denominator monomials; never raw blocked or numerator factors
grammar.ranking: full grouped output or ORDER BY final genuine percentage alias DESC with optional secondary output keys and LIMIT
grammar.result_aliases: unquoted ASCII names case-insensitive in SQLite fixtures; collisions rejected; original bytes retained
unsupported: ungrouped non-key columns mixed with aggregates

limit_boundary_ties.captured_rows: Exact projected values and count; claimant team must occur in selected host capture.
limit_boundary_ties.claim: Exact global co-max set unchanged; false unique claims still contradicted.
limit_boundary_ties.explicit_keys: Every declared secondary/tertiary key remains binding.
limit_boundary_ties.selection: All strictly preceding rows are mandatory; fill remaining positions with distinct members equal on every declared ORDER BY key at the LIMIT boundary. Exact snapshot-derived rational keys; no rounding or claim-tolerance tie grouping.

metric: 100 * sum(active blocked) / count(active rows) per original team

outcomes.contradicted: trusted evidence conflicts with binding, population, lineage, ranking, captured result or claim
outcomes.insufficient: untrusted/missing/failed/incomplete/invalid/unsupported evidence; not a false semantic answer
outcomes.proven: supported computation in the synthetic host fixture; never live qualification

ranking: exact unrounded rational ratios over every eligible team
ties: all exact co-max teams; unique_winner must be false for a tie

trust.capture_identity: nonserializable object identity resolved independently and pinned by expected.capture_ref
trust.limit: Host arguments must be independently controlled. This library is not a sandbox against a malicious host/Python caller. Checksums and origin strings cannot authenticate a serialized agent envelope.
